title: Dr Frost Arctic Apple Black Honeydew Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Dr Frost Arctic Shortfill Apple Black Honeydew Ice combines crisp Apple, tangy Blackcurrant, and delicately sweet Honeydew Melon flavours, all balanced with a frosty menthol exhale. This vibrant blend delivers layers of fruity flavour and cooling refreshment, making it an ideal choice for vapers seeking bold fruit and ice e-liquid combinations. Part of Dr Frost’s Arctic Edition collection, this shortfill features double-concentrated ‘Bar Salts’ flavour, offering the same intense taste profiles that vapers enjoy in disposable vapes. Unlike traditional high-VG shortfills, Arctic Shortfills are crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, making them perfect for low-powered Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and pod kits. The 100ml bottle leaves space for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing vapers to customise their nicotine strength or enjoy nicotine-free. Dr Frost Arctic Shortfills are a versatile and economical option for adult smokers and vapers seeking bold flavours and exceptional value.
